remaining_uncertainty: Runtime exploitability was not individually assessed in the API_SE_001 documentation/discovery mutation cone.

entries.symptom: Initial read-only Docker container discovery could not access the desktop Docker socket from the default sandbox.

entries.symptom: The first fingerprint attempt failed before backup/target creation because psql autocommit dropped the temporary count table.
entries.expected: The session-scoped temporary table remains available to the PL/pgSQL scan and final aggregate query.

repair_attempts: Removed ON COMMIT DROP so the temporary table remains for the psql session.
remaining_uncertainty: The passing repair proves the local logical drill only.
entries.next_action: Keep the failed attempt referenced by every API_SE_014 proof and retain the fingerprint mismatch gate.

entries.symptom: The first recovery test used the regular-expression dot-all flag, which is newer than the repository TypeScript target.

entries.next_action: Preserve the repository target in future contract-test syntax.

entries.symptom: The first production build warned that the shared telemetry module imported node:crypto in an Edge-runtime bundle.
entries.expected: Shared telemetry semantics compile for every Next.js runtime that imports instrumentation/catalog code.
entries.actual: Tenant hashing pulled node:crypto into the Edge graph; the same sandboxed build also hit the already-known external Google Font fetch boundary.

repair_attempts: Removed tenant hashing and omitted tenant/actor identity entirely from shared telemetry.
deferred_external_infra: Sandboxed Google Font fetch; rerun requires network access and is not telemetry capability evidence.
remaining_uncertainty: No Edge deployment or telemetry exporter was exercised.
entries.next_action: Keep the shared telemetry module runtime-neutral and perform exporter-specific crypto only in explicitly Node-owned adapters.

entries.symptom: TypeScript did not preserve the selected profile narrowing inside the asynchronous worker closure.

Scoped temporary table ownership inside each disposable database to the proof-only login.
Published every new route and method through the existing canonical topology and completeness tests.

entries.symptom: The first proof seed skipped positional PostgreSQL parameters, and after that harness repair the first claimed delivery lacked the linked receipt target/resulting-version fields required by the provider contract and therefore failed closed as DEAD_LETTERED; the first route source fixture also expected a literal version rather than its imported constant.

Changed the source-sensitive route fixture to require canonical constant use instead of duplicate text.
remaining_uncertainty: The deterministic simulator does not establish any real provider payload or version semantics.
entries.next_action: Keep the payload-hash and linked-receipt projection fail-closed for every real adapter.

entries.symptom: The initial worker entrypoint used top-level await under the repository's CommonJS tsx mode, then inherited Next.js-only server-only resolution from the shared store; the first operator readback also emitted node-postgres's deprecation warning by issuing concurrent queries on one checked-out client.
entries.expected: The declared worker command starts as a standalone Node process, uses the canonical database TLS policy, closes its pool, and performs supported sequential operations per checked-out client.
entries.actual: The worker now runs through an async main, constructs its own bounded Pool from databaseConnectionOptions, receives the Pool through the shared store constructor, closes it on exit, and operator aggregates execute sequentially; the command reaches its explicit missing-configuration guard and final disposable proofs emit no client warning.
evidence_refs: final warning-free fresh and observed_worker PASS output
repair_attempts: Wrapped the process loop in async main with bounded error output and Pool cleanup.
Separated the reusable Pool-injected store from the Next route's server-only database construction.
Replaced Promise.all on one PoolClient with sequential aggregate queries.
remaining_uncertainty: No deployed process manager, autoscaling behavior or production shutdown observation exists.
entries.next_action: Bind any deployed worker to an exact release identity and exercise restart/shutdown under managed load before activation.
